lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Cu2Mo2 (reduced formula Mg6CuMo) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Cu, Mg, and Mo centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.89 to 3.24 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Cu- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
